item.title: Zangi (Hokkaido Fried Chicken) — Guide
item.description: Zangi is Hokkaido’s much-loved style of Japanese fried chicken, similar to karaage but with its own local identity and, many say, a bolder, richer flavour. Believed to have originated in Kushiro in eastern Hokkaido, zangi is made by marinating bite-sized pieces of chicken (often bone-in) in a well-seasoned mixture of soy sauce, garlic, ginger and other flavourings, then coating them in starch or flour and deep-frying until juicy inside and crisp outside.
